method: Same-origin browser demonstration against generated shared and India artifacts

logging.observation: Logged Chicken breast (grilled) 200g; dashboard showed one meal, 330 kcal and 62 g protein.

adjustment.observation: Opened Adjust sizes before logging, increased chicken breast to 250 g and logged it; the second meal showed 413 kcal and 78 g protein.

save.observation: Saved the logged meal and found it in the Add meal Saved section.

exclusion.observation: Hid chicken breast through Manage meal; the Hidden bar and tap-to-restore control appeared.

targetEdit.observation: Changed protein target from 140 g to 150 g, observed SAVED and then /150 on the dashboard.

history.observation: History showed 1/7 days logged, two meals, 743 average kcal and 140 g average protein.

limitations: This browser evidence is a focused workflow demonstration, not exhaustive UI-path coverage; automated storage-contract and configuration tests provide the complementary test evidence.
